title: Background intake: Issue -> run -> PR
description: Slice 5. Runner: `aftergrid intake` CLI (poll Issues labelled ready-for-agent, run the harness headless with the hook installed, open a PR linking the Issue with the full Finding directory); a GitHub Actions recipe is documented as optional. Missing definition approval or provisional sign-off pauses with a needs-input result posted on the Issue; reruns are idempotent (no duplicate PRs); hook precedes any unattended run. Workflow boundary test with fake Issue and harness interfaces feeding a real fixture Finding.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Label -> PR with linked Issue in boundary test
- [ ] Needs-input pause exercised
- [ ] Duplicate trigger yields no second PR

title: Distribution: plugin, skills.sh, npm, docs
description: Slice 6. Plugin manifest listing promoted skills, skills.sh-compatible layout, openai.yaml per skill with invocation policy in sync, npm package for the CLI, install smoke test, docs page per promoted skill, README with install block, MIT + Matt Pocock notice where wording adapted.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] claude plugin validate passes; install smoke green
- [ ] npx aftergrid check/render work from a clean machine
- [ ] Every promoted skill has a docs page and openai.yaml

title: Execute + Check via DuckDB adapter
description: Slice 1. Adapter contract (execute with typed columns, capture with content hashes, open-retained, privilege probe, non-executing estimate with unknown, resource limits, statement guard, catalog read) implemented for DuckDB; capabilities DuckDB lacks (roles) are recorded as unsupported in the capability matrix, which starts here and is generated from the seam-2 suite. Snapshot = immutable retained copy with hashes. One reconciliation Check (canonical definition SQL vs analysis result) runs through the adapter against retained inputs; failing reconciliation and Snapshot hash mismatch are red.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] check executes exemplar SQL and Checks against retained inputs, never live
- [ ] Snapshot hashes recorded; mismatch fixture fails
- [ ] Seam-2 suite green on DuckDB; capability matrix generated with DuckDB row (privilege probe = unsupported)
- [ ] Guard admits reads only via estimate under cap or documented fallback; LIMIT alone never passes

title: Evidence rules, `aftergrid decide`, and negative fixtures
description: Slice 2. Every evidence rule enforced and red for the right reason: decimal precision preserved, null vs not-available vs zero, display-only rounding, renderer-side derivation op set with declared operands/units/zero-denominator behaviour and cycle rejection, duplicate row keys, missing columns, hand-typed data-bearing numerals, typed external sources for targets, Claim type + Recheck policy presence and shape, definition kind metric|diagnostic separate from lifecycle, published decision metric citing proposed or unversioned definition. Plus `aftergrid decide`: a CLI command (no model) that writes a Decision record (owner, action or deliberate inaction, rationale, date, revisit condition, Claim ids) citing a Finding, validates it, and appends it to the Instance decision log; merging never creates one.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Each seam-1 negative fixture fails with the expected category, using the synthetic failure fixtures where they apply
- [ ] Recheck policy + falsifier + Decision-record shapes validated
- [ ] Diagnostic calculations allowed with status shown; published metric requires approved + pinned version
- [ ] `aftergrid decide` writes a valid Decision record; invalid input rejected with reason

title: Exemplar Findings by hand + Reader mock review
description: Slice 1, no code. Write the Finding contract as artifacts a human can review before any implementation: (1) the manifest schema as a documented JSON Schema (schema_version, ids with restricted charset, executions, result sets with row keys/types/units, Claims with type + Recheck policy, Question with falsifier, export policy, owner contact, digest + attestation placeholders); (2) the reference grammar; (3) the Instance layout and Reader-profile format with generic fallback; (4) two hand-written exemplar Findings on a tiny DuckDB input: one numeric (a retention comparison with two Claims, one chart, one table) and one nonnumeric (insufficient data, with the why-Claim); (5) a hand-built static HTML mock of the numeric exemplar exactly as `render` should produce it. Show the mock to one non-data person and record what they understood, what they asked, and what they would do. This is the product thesis test in plan space; every later ticket builds to these files.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] JSON Schema + reference grammar + Instance layout + Reader-profile format committed as docs
- [ ] Two exemplar Finding directories complete by hand (memo, manifest, queries, results, Checks, chart spec)
- [ ] Static HTML mock reviewed by one non-data person; feedback recorded and folded back into the exemplars
- [ ] Exemplars reference every manifest field at least once

title: Automated real Finding: Spot Sports podcast/video readout via /analyze on Postgres
description: Slice 4. Re-run the podcast/video readout end to end with the skills: /setup-aftergrid on the existing spot_sports Instance, Postgres extract via the adapter, /analyze from the raw ask, review, merge, render, `aftergrid decide`. Compare against the hand-authored Finding from the manual ticket: same Claims, same numbers within tolerance, or a documented reason. Nothing private enters the aftergrid repo.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Finding passes check (validity + readiness) and renders
- [ ] Reader subagent passes under the named profile
- [ ] Matches hand-authored Finding's Claims and numbers, or differences explained
- [ ] Decision record written via `aftergrid decide`

title: /grill-question + /checked-analysis
description: Slice 3. /grill-question (user-invoked) runs grilling + domain-modeling: raw ask -> Question artifact (decision, metric, population, window, machine-checkable falsifier, Reader); proposes definitions as proposed; updates the Instance glossary. /checked-analysis (model-invoked): pre-registers the primary comparison, writes invariant + reconciliation Checks before the analysis query, runs against a Snapshot, records Diagnostic calculations with status, and produces the Analysis directory /write-finding consumes. Evidence: recorded run committed as fixture.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Question artifact validates against schema; falsifier stored as Check ref + expected outcome
- [ ] Checks exist before analysis SQL runs; run order enforced
- [ ] Analysis directory output is consumable by /write-finding unchanged

title: Guardrail hook
description: Slice 5. Claude Code PreToolUse hook blocking shell/SQL invocations that write, run DDL or exceed budget; provisional-read path requires a sign-off record in the Instance (source, reason code, approver, date, expiry) referenced by the run log, results never rendered; hard permissions/privacy/limits have no bridge. Installable by setup; tested against alternate access paths (psql, duckdb CLI, node one-liners). Adapter guards give the same floor to harnesses without hooks.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Write/DDL/over-budget attempts blocked with reason
- [ ] Alternate-path tests red without hook, green with
- [ ] Provisional read without sign-off blocked

title: /iterate-visual + /revise-finding
description: Slice 3. /iterate-visual: render -> view PNG -> score against the Storytelling-with-Data rubric -> revise; three passes maximum, still-failing chart returned to the Operator; score advisory only. /revise-finding (user-invoked): Operator feedback -> re-render + re-check; Variants share pinned evidence; presentation-only changes allowed; number/query or interpretation changes (causal wording, hidden comparison, aggregation, axis truncation) reopen analysis/review with a clear message. Decision records are not written here; use `aftergrid decide`.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Loop stops at 3 and reports failure to Operator; recorded run committed
- [ ] Interpretation change detected and review invalidated; presentation change re-renders only
- [ ] Variant pick keeps evidence bindings identical across Variants

title: Hand-authored real Finding on a Spot Sports extract (DuckDB)
description: Slice 2. Before any skill exists: export the podcast/video readout data from Spot Sports to a bounded DuckDB extract by hand, write the Finding by hand under the contract (Question with falsifier, approved definitions in the private Instance, Checks, Claims with Recheck policies, chart specs), run check and render, and put the HTML in front of one non-data person. Record what they understood, asked, and decided. This is the earliest real-data, real-Reader test and de-risks every skill ticket. Nothing private enters the aftergrid repo; the Finding lives in spot_sports/analytics.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Extract + Finding pass check (validity) and render
- [ ] One non-data Reader review recorded: explained the Answer, named the denominator and a limitation, chose an action
- [ ] Contract gaps found are filed as beads with discovered-from edges
- [ ] Reader-profile for 'non-technical product owner' written from the session

title: Nightly golden eval workflow
description: Slice 6. Scheduled workflow runs /analyze end to end on every golden Question against the synthetic dataset and stores results (pass/fail per assertion, answer, definition id, tables read) with skill version, git SHA and model id; a summary is posted to the repo. Not a merge gate.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Nightly job green at least once
- [ ] Results stored per run with versions; regression visible in summary
- [ ] Failure on an expected-abstention case is reported as a failure

title: Postgres adapter + capability matrix
description: Slice 4. Adapter contract for Postgres: capture of declared dependency tables inside one REPEATABLE READ transaction with content hashes; open-retained restores extracts into a disposable compatible Postgres with recorded schema/runtime requirements and reruns original SQL there, never falling back to live; EXPLAIN (no ANALYZE) estimate in planner units with unknown; statement_timeout/work_mem limits; guard with no LIMIT exemption; privilege probe; catalog read. Capability matrix generated from suite sections; PostHog managed warehouse listed unvalidated.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Seam-2 suite parameterised over DuckDB + Postgres green; capability matrix gains Postgres row
- [ ] Mutate live after capture; rerun from retained inputs reproduces original result
- [ ] LIMIT query with over-cap estimate rejected; unknown estimate follows documented fallback
- [ ] No compatible Postgres available -> rerun reports unavailable, replay still works; never live fallback
- [ ] Unsupported capability fails or explicit fallback, never green/zero

title: Publication binding: digest, attestations, export projection
description: Slice 2. Digest envelope over semantic manifest + memo/query/Check/chart-spec/result contents and the house-style version, excluding the digest itself, attestations, rendered outputs and volatile timestamps. Attestations (Check results, definition approvals, reviews) bind to the digest and are verified against a trust source independent of agent-editable fields. v0 trust source: a GitHub pull-request review in APPROVED state at the Finding's exact commit SHA by a login in the Instance's approver allowlist, read via the GitHub API; when the API is unreachable, readiness is reported unknown and only a labelled draft renders. check report separates evidence validity from publication readiness and never mutates hashed content. render for publication refuses unbound or stale attestations.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Stale digest, forged self-authored attestation, post-attestation edit each fail publication
- [ ] Changing only a Claim type or exclusion invalidates the Finding review; cosmetic edit does not require definition re-approval
- [ ] Definition approval binds definition content; Finding approval binds Finding digest
- [ ] Approval by a login outside the allowlist, or at a different SHA, is rejected; API unreachable -> readiness unknown, draft only
- [ ] Draft render works without attestations, labelled, reader-safe projection applied

title: Render to inspected HTML
description: Slice 1. Vega-Lite subset validator (allowlist over nested/layered specs and encodings; no transform, aggregate, bin, timeUnit, stack-normalise, inline data, URLs) and renderer to SVG, plus PNG for agent viewing via a wasm rasteriser (no native deps), with a versioned shared house style. `aftergrid render` produces one self-contained HTML matching the reviewed mock from the exemplars ticket: Answer first, per-Claim understand/inspect expansion (population, comparison, window, exclusions, calculation), trust facts as separate lines, coverage + generated-at + canonical location, single mailto action with Finding + Claim ids only, draft label when unattested.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] render succeeds on both exemplars and matches the reviewed HTML mock; forbidden chart spec fails validation
- [ ] HTML contains no field outside export policy; sentinel test on HTML + SVG incl. metadata
- [ ] Reader action carries ids, no values
- [ ] Draft label present when attestations absent
- [ ] No native build dependency in the install

title: /analysis-review + /analyze + first golden eval
description: Slice 3. /analysis-review dispatches Method, Question and Reader subagents (Reader adopts Instance profile) in parallel, returns blocking/non-blocking findings. /analyze (user-invoked) declares the gate order: grill -> checked-analysis -> write-finding -> iterate-visual -> analysis-review -> check; halts with reason on any blocking finding; inconclusive is a valid outcome. One golden Question seeded on the fixture data runs end to end and asserts answer/abstention, definition id, tables read.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] /analyze produces a check-passing Finding from a raw ask on synthetic data; recorded run committed
- [ ] Blocking review finding halts the run with reason; inconclusive outcome passes
- [ ] First golden eval green and stored with skill version, git SHA, model id

title: aftergrid revisit (v0.1): re-test merged Findings against refreshed Snapshot
description: ADR 0009 (amended). v0.1: refresh Snapshot as new retained inputs -> rerun executions under each Claim's declared window policy -> evaluate each Recheck policy + the Question's falsifier -> new revision reporting per Claim: holds / contradicted / insufficient data / not comparable (distinct from engine Check failures; non-evaluable is an explicit state, never a fabricated boolean). Lists the Decision records resting on each Claim; the decision owner judges, the Engine never infers 'decision holds'. Decision log rendered as a board. Marketing: 'the analysis that re-checks itself'.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Revisit produces a new revision with new retained inputs; original guarantees untouched
- [ ] Each Claim reports holds / contradicted / insufficient data / not comparable
- [ ] Decision log board lists Decision records per Claim result; no inferred verdicts

title: Revisit schema in v0 manifest: Recheck policy, falsifier Check, Decision-record revisit condition
description: ADR 0009 (amended). v0 manifest carries, per Claim, a tagged Recheck policy: predicate + threshold/direction, comparison method or versioned method ref, evidence refs, tolerance units + baseline where applicable, minimum-data/coverage, window policy (fixed-window restatement vs advancing-window), OR not-automatically-evaluable + reason (explicit state, never a fabricated boolean). Question falsifier = Check ref + expected outcome, distinct from non-evaluable. Decision record = Claim ids it rests on + revisit condition (schedule and/or falsifier ref); window policy lives on the Claim, not the Decision record. check validates shape + references only; no evaluator in v0. Recheck results (holds / contradicted / insufficient data / not comparable) are distinct from engine Check failures. Sources: spec, ADR 0001-0009.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Recheck policy, falsifier and Decision-record shapes in the JSON Schema with examples in both exemplars
- [ ] check rejects a Claim without a Recheck policy, a policy with no predicate and no non-evaluable reason, a Decision record without Claim ids
- [ ] Non-evaluable is a distinct state; no boolean default

title: /setup-aftergrid
description: Slice 4. User-invoked setup: scaffolds the Instance (definitions, readers, findings, decision log, golden Questions), verifies mattpocock-skills is installed (exact install line if not), writes a connection profile and refuses a role whose probed privileges include write/DDL, installs the guardrail hook via the hook-point, records the tracker choice. Hard vs soft dependency split documented.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Fresh repo -> usable Instance in one run; rerun idempotent
- [ ] Write-capable role refused with reason
- [ ] Setup smoke test in CI

title: Skeleton + `aftergrid check` on the exemplars
description: Slice 1. Repo layout mirroring mattpocock-skills (buckets, CLAUDE.md rules, plugin manifest stub), TypeScript CLI scaffold with no native build dependencies, `aftergrid new finding <slug>` scaffolding a Finding directory with a valid manifest skeleton and fresh ids, and `aftergrid check` validating the exemplars against the JSON Schema and resolving every evidence reference by row key with a category report. Seam-1 harness runs both exemplars in CI.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] check passes on both exemplars; fails with category report on an unresolved-reference fixture
- [ ] `aftergrid new finding` output passes schema validation untouched
- [ ] Reference resolution by row key only; missing/duplicate keys rejected
- [ ] Seam-1 harness in CI; npx runs with no native compile step

title: Synthetic dataset generator + failure fixtures + golden Questions
description: Slice 2 (moved earlier). Deterministic generator: PostHog-shaped users/events/subscriptions with planted effects (churn spike, broken funnel step, mix shift) and failure fixtures (duplicate joins, zero denominators, late events, missing instrumentation, insufficient data). 3-5 golden Questions with expected answer or expected abstention and tolerances, written as Question artifacts. Used by the evidence-rules ticket for negatives and by every later skill ticket for evals.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Generator reproducible from seed; DuckDB file built in CI
- [ ] Failure fixtures documented with the rule each one should trip
- [ ] Golden suite includes at least one expected-abstention case; Question artifacts validate against schema

title: v0 milestone evidence
description: Slice 6. Assemble the release: golden suite green at the release revision; Reader smoke test on the real Finding (one outside person explains the Answer, names denominator + a limitation, picks an action); capability matrix published; repo flipped public; formative study scheduled as the external-release gate.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Golden green at tagged revision
- [ ] Reader smoke test recorded
- [ ] Capability matrix published; PostHog managed warehouse marked unvalidated
- [ ] Repo public

title: v0: one Finding end to end
description: Spec: docs/spec/v0-one-finding-end-to-end.md (public mirror: GitHub issue #1). Design: docs/design/v0-design-2026-09-15.md. Glossary: CONTEXT.md. ADRs: docs/adr/0001-0009. Independent review reconciled in docs/design/reconciliation-2026-09-15.md; cleared for ticketing at 532bd78.
design:
Slices (revised after bead review 2026-09-15), each ends in a passing seam test or a recorded human review:
1. Contract first, then one retained DuckDB answer to inspected HTML: exemplar Findings by hand + Reader mock review (no code) -> skeleton + check -> DuckDB execute/Check -> render matching the mock.
2. Real data early + reject invalid evidence: synthetic generator + golden Questions; evidence rules + `aftergrid decide` + negatives; publication binding (GitHub PR review as trust source); hand-authored real Spot Sports Finding on a DuckDB extract with a real Reader.
3. Author and revise the same artifact: /grill-question + /checked-analysis (parallel with) /write-finding + /shape-narrative -> /iterate-visual + /revise-finding -> /analysis-review + /analyze + first golden eval.
4. Onboard and run on Postgres: setup, Postgres adapter, automated real Finding compared against the hand-authored one.
5. Run asynchronously: guardrail hook; `aftergrid intake` runner with needs-input pause.
6. Distribution + milestone evidence: distribution; nightly eval; milestone.
Frontier starts at ag-finding-exemplars. Decision records are CLI (`aftergrid decide`), not a skill.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] golden Questions green in CI on synthetic dataset
- [ ] first Spot Sports Finding (podcast/video readout) passes Reader reviewer under non-technical product owner profile
- [ ] one outside person explains Answer in own words, names denominator + a limitation, picks an action
- [ ] every displayed number resolves from a saved result; check + render pass on fixtures
notes: COMPLETED: design grilled, reviewed by CobaltSpring, reconciled; spec written (docs/spec) and mirrored to GitHub #1. IN PROGRESS: nothing. NEXT: /to-tickets against the spec -> child beads under this epic. KEY DECISIONS: internal dev tracking = beads (br); product Instance intake stays GitHub Issues (a feature, not our process).

title: /write-finding + /shape-narrative
description: Slice 3. Model-invoked skills written under writing-for-agents. /write-finding consumes an Analysis directory (Question, executions, results, Checks) and produces the Finding: fixed sections, Claims with type and Recheck policy, chart specs, manifest, selecting the named Reader profile (generic fallback). /shape-narrative enforces answer-first, one Claim per Evidence subsection, chart title = Claim, Reader-level language, Claim type + caveat beside the Answer. Output must pass check with zero manual edits. Evidence: a recorded run whose resulting Finding directory is committed as a fixture, plus a golden eval.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] On the numeric exemplar's Analysis inputs, skill output passes check (validity) with zero manual edits; run recorded and committed
- [ ] Nonnumeric outcome produces a valid Finding
- [ ] Narrative lint rules enforced by check; reviewer criteria named for what lint cannot see
